[[File:Dead_Man_Switch_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|A Gran pilot with his cockpit rigged with a dead-man switch]]
A '''dead-man switch''' was incorporated into the handles of [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]] such as the [[Ikas-Adno/Legends|Ikas-Adno]] [[Starhawk speeder bike/Legends|Starhawk]]. If the pilot of the vehicle let go, in situations where they perhaps would fall off the bike, the dead-man switch would cut the engine and leave the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsors]] running. It could also refer to a type of booby trap where an individual would set explosives to trigger if a certain condition is met.<ref name="XWING">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>
